title: Q-SPEC-14-LIVE-STORES: the L1 tick suite on a live Postgres, and the remaining L1 steps on a document store (US-14-T01, US-14-R11)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** specification audit 2026-11-26 (specs/ against the code)
**Done check:** cmd:git ls-files --error-unmatch workers/adapters/postgres/live.test.js
**Status:** open

Two PLANNED rows of `specs/US-SPEC-14-portability-seams.md`. (1) `workers/adapters/postgres/index.js` is proven as translated text against a recording client and never against a server: add `workers/adapters/postgres/live.test.js` that runs the L1 tick suite and a claim-contention test over the handle against a Postgres service container, skipped with a stated reason when no server is reachable, and run it in a workflow job that starts the container. (2) `workers/adapters/docdb/index.js` rewrites reconcile, trust and dispatch; rewrite the other five L1 steps and compare each with its SQL step on the same data in `workers/adapters/docdb/docdb.test.js`. Then set both rows to BUILT with the file and test. A hosted document-database driver stays PLANNED: it needs a live account.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `node --test workers/adapters/postgres/live.test.js workers/adapters/docdb/docdb.test.js`
**Prediction:** portability_planned_rows <= 3 within 720 h
**Out of scope:** a hosted document-database account or driver; a managed Postgres for production; changing the core's SQL.
